comment: C-first bounded continuation frozen from the recorded three-potion selector and source order before recording and JavaScript comparison. The prior C selector showed `k - 3 milky potions.` and `[d k or ?*]`. C potion.c:dodrink tests the milky descriptor and live-ghost flag for each bottle, rolls rn2(13+2*ghosts-born), calls ghost_from_bottle only on zero, otherwise proceeds to dopotion; each attempt consumes one bottle. The suffix makes at most three attempts and preserves ordinary random-arm misses.
